title: WIDGET / Esthetic: 1 space between numbers
symptom: The widget numbers are stuck together without a leading space, making them hard to read when the info is long. Additionally, the widget information is not centered on the screen; it sticks to the right side. On some devices, the widget needs to be as large as 3x5 slots to display all information, and the background is too transparent.
fix: The maintainer suggests making the widget wider and playing with system text size, but no specific fix is provided.
